doc_summary: `native_screen_key_released_pre(screen, key, modifiers, canceled)` runs before a named key's release reaches an open screen, with the same screen exclusions and GLFW modifier encoding as the existing key-press hook. It does not fire for presses/repeats or unnamed keys. Cancel bypasses screen handling and its legacy native_key notification, but physical key removal and mapped keyboard/toggle releases still happen to prevent stuck inputs. Mouse mappings retain their existing gameplay-only gate. Bundles need "hooks": @API:screen_key_released@.
